after.summary: USA Swimming groups its Local Swimming Committees into four administrative zones. The 2026 rulebook enumerates 58 LSCs: Eastern 12, Central 14, Southern 15 and Western 17. Ohio and Lake Erie merged effective September 1, 2025. Article 606 permits regional competition arrangements without establishing a mandatory zone → region → LSC hierarchy.
after.coverageNote: Nationwide LSC inventory collected: 13 existing records retained and 45 additions proposed across three zone batches. Full 58-LSC coverage depends on acceptance of all three batches. Source detail and regional/club coverage remain partial, with gaps flagged individually.
